id: 07_Meet Michael Mills -- Host of the ACS Safety Videos
title: 认识化学安全系列视频的主持人
source_doc: course/ACS College Lab Safety Series/07_Meet Michael Mills -- Host of the ACS Safety Videos.md
author_source: project/ACS College Lab Safety Series/07_Meet Michael Mills -- Host of the ACS Safety Videos/src.py

points.K2: 好奇心是走近科学的起点
points.K6: 听专家的：安全为什么优先
points.K9: 化学品名字要反复念准
points.K11: 和上实验课一样的防护
points.K13: 迷茫时，想想最初的热爱

shots.scene: 欣欣站在摄影棚里，身后有补光灯和摄像机，向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in a small film studio with soft lights and a camera on a tripod behind it, waving at the camera.
shots.narration: 这一课，带你看看安全课的幕后。
overlay: 安全课幕后：为什么安全放在第一位

shots.scene: 场记板、护目镜、紧急喷淋、四个台阶图标排成一行
shots.prompt_en: Four icons in a row: a blank film clapperboard, safety goggles, an emergency shower, and four steps going up. No people.
shots.narration: 拍安全课的人，自己学到了什么？

shots.scene: 阿杰在化学实验课上托着下巴发呆，面前是空白的实验报告
shots.prompt_en: The young male student sits at a lab bench in a lab coat, resting his chin on his hand and staring at a blank lab report.
shots.narration: 阿杰上化学课，觉得自己不是这块料。

shots.scene: 阿杰看着墙上一长串空白的规则清单，皱眉
shots.prompt_en: The young male student frowns at a long blank rules poster on the lab wall.
shots.narration: 他还嫌安全规定太多，太麻烦。

shots.scene: 小研拍拍他的肩，指向一旁的欣欣
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student taps the young male student on the shoulder and points to the panda mascot nearby.
shots.narration: 小研说：听欣欣讲讲拍安全课的事。

shots.scene: 欣欣坐在高脚凳上，像接受采访一样面向镜头
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot sits on a tall stool facing the camera as if in an interview, with a soft light beside it.
shots.narration: 我也是从不懂，到真正懂了安全。

shots.scene: 欣欣身旁浮现视频、书本、手机屏幕三个图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside floating icons of a video player, an open book and a phone screen, all blank.
shots.narration: 讲科学，可以用视频、文章和各种媒体。

shots.scene: 地球图标周围是许多不同的小人图标
shots.prompt_en: A globe icon surrounded by many small diverse person pictograms. No people.
shots.narration: 目标是让不同背景的人，都能听懂。

shots.scene: 一个灯泡图标从屏幕里飞到一个个小人头上
shots.prompt_en: A light bulb icon flies out of a screen and lands above several small person pictograms. No people.
shots.narration: 好的科学内容，应该人人都能得到。

shots.section_title: 好奇心是走近科学的起点
shots.scene: 夜晚的树林，蝙蝠飞过，一只小鹿跑过
shots.prompt_en: A calm night forest scene with bats flying overhead and a young deer running between trees. No people.
shots.narration: 很多人走近科学，是从好奇开始的。
overlay: 好奇心是走近科学的起点

shots.section_title: 好奇心是走近科学的起点
shots.scene: 小研蹲在树林边，举着手电观察
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student crouches at the edge of a forest at dusk, watching with a flashlight.
shots.narration: 看到夜里出没的动物，就想弄个明白。

shots.section_title: 好奇心是走近科学的起点
shots.scene: 问号图标变成灯泡图标
shots.prompt_en: A question mark icon turns into a glowing light bulb icon. No people.
shots.narration: 这份好奇，是理解自然的动力。

shots.scene: 一条弯弯曲曲的小路，终点是实验楼
shots.prompt_en: A winding path with several turns leading to a science building in the distance. No people.
shots.narration: 成长的路，不一定是一条直线。

shots.scene: 话筒、舞台、讲台三个图标连成一条线，最后指向科学图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a microphone, a stage and a lectern linked by arrows, ending at a flask icon. No people.
shots.narration: 学过的本领，比如在台上表达，

shots.scene: 欣欣站在讲台后，身后屏幕空白，台下学生在听
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands behind a lectern in front of a blank screen while students listen.
shots.narration: 都可能在讲科学时派上用场。

shots.scene: 狭小的实验室里，摄像机、灯架旁挤着欣欣、老周、老李和小研
shots.prompt_en: A small lab crowded with a camera and light stands; the panda mascot, the older man, the facility engineer and the female graduate student work close together.
shots.narration: 拍安全课时，小小的实验室挤满了人。

shots.scene: 老李扶住灯架、整理线缆，小研侧身让出通道
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer steadies a light stand and tidies cables along the wall while the female graduate student steps aside to make room.
shots.narration: 大家守时、专业，又彼此友好。

shots.scene: 线缆被整齐贴在墙边，通道畅通，打勾
shots.prompt_en: Cables taped neatly along the wall with a clear walkway, with a green check mark. No people.
shots.narration: 空间再小，彼此尊重、配合好就顺利。

shots.scene: 欣欣站在实验台前，戴着护目镜
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands at a lab bench wearing safety goggles.
shots.narration: 拍下来，我最大的收获是安全知识。

shots.scene: 三个图标：走进实验室、在台前操作、举手负责的小人
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: a person entering a lab door, a person working at a bench, and a person raising a hand with a check mark. No people.
shots.narration: 进实验室、做实验，都要对安全负责。

shots.scene: 一个小人身后连着周围好几个小人的图标
shots.prompt_en: A person pictogram connected by lines to several surrounding person pictograms. No people.
shots.narration: 不只对自己，也对身边的人。

shots.section_title: 听专家的：安全为什么优先
shots.scene: 老周拿着空白剧本，给戴护目镜的小研讲解
shots.prompt_en: The older man holds a blank script and explains something to the female graduate student, who wears goggles and a lab coat.
shots.narration: 拍摄时，有专家把关每一个动作。
overlay: 听专家的：安全为什么优先

shots.section_title: 听专家的：安全为什么优先
shots.scene: 该做、不该做两列图标，一列打勾，一列打叉
shots.prompt_en: Two columns of small action icons: one column with green checks, the other crossed out with red X. No people.
shots.narration: 哪些该做，哪些不能做，一一讲清。

shots.section_title: 听专家的：安全为什么优先
shots.scene: 老周指着实验台，小研认真点头
shots.prompt_en: The older man points at the bench and explains the reason; the female graduate student nods thoughtfully.
shots.narration: 不只讲规定，还讲为什么这样规定。

shots.section_title: 听专家的：安全为什么优先
shots.scene: 天平图标：一边是盾牌，一边是时钟和成果，盾牌那边更重
shots.prompt_en: A balance scale icon with a shield on one side and a clock with a trophy on the other; the shield side is heavier. No people.
shots.narration: 这才明白：安全要放在第一位。

shots.scene: 欣欣对着摄像机一遍遍试讲，身旁有提词板
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot rehearses in front of a camera again and again, with a blank cue board beside it.
shots.narration: 在镜头前，一句话要讲很多遍。

shots.scene: 欣欣对着学生微笑讲解
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot smiles and explains to a group of students in a classroom.
shots.narration: 带着热情，用自己的方式讲出来。

shots.scene: 紧急喷淋标志和喷淋装置
shots.prompt_en: An emergency shower sign above an emergency safety shower with its pull handle. No people.
shots.narration: 拍摄中印象最深的，是紧急喷淋。

shots.scene: 欣欣站在喷淋下拉下拉手，大量水落下，表情吃惊
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot pulls the handle of the safety shower and a huge rush of water falls on it; it looks surprised.
shots.narration: 一拉，水一下子倾泻而下。

shots.scene: 欣欣湿漉漉地竖起大拇指
shots.prompt_en: The soaking wet panda mascot gives a thumbs up.
shots.narration: 试过一次，才知道真用时会是什么样。

shots.section_title: 化学品名字要反复念准
shots.scene: 欣欣对着一长串化学名称卡片，舌头打结
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot looks at a row of blank chemical name cards with a tangled tongue icon above its head.
shots.narration: 化学品的名字，又长又拗口。
overlay: 化学品名字要念准、看清

shots.section_title: 化学品名字要反复念准
shots.scene: 一摞科学课本，上方一个自信的笑脸图标
shots.prompt_en: A pile of science textbooks with a small confident smile icon above it. No people.
shots.narration: 有科学基础，念起来从容一些。

shots.section_title: 化学品名字要反复念准
shots.scene: 欣欣对着空白卡片一遍遍练习发音
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot practices reading a blank card aloud again and again, mouth moving carefully.
shots.narration: 还是要一遍遍地念，直到念准。

shots.scene: 摄影棚和实验室之间画着四个台阶
shots.prompt_en: Four step icons drawn between a film set icon and a lab bench icon. No people.
shots.narration: 拍摄现场，也按安全四步来做。

shots.scene: 老周在空白清单上逐项打勾，摄像机在旁
shots.prompt_en: The older man ticks off items on a blank checklist beside a camera on a tripod.
shots.narration: 开拍前识别危害、评估风险、做好准备。

shots.scene: 只有摄像机机位移动的示意，化学品图标保持在安全区
shots.prompt_en: A diagram where only the camera icon moves to new angles while chemical bottle icons stay inside a marked safe zone. No people.
shots.narration: 能变的只是机位，安全要求一样不少。

shots.section_title: 和上实验课一样的防护
shots.scene: 欣欣戴上护目镜，穿上实验服
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot puts on safety goggles and buttons up a lab coat.
shots.narration: 拍摄的防护，和上实验课一模一样。
overlay: 和上实验课一样的防护

shots.section_title: 和上实验课一样的防护
shots.scene: 长发束起、手机放进柜子的两个图标打勾
shots.prompt_en: Two icons with green checks: long hair tied back, and a phone placed in a locker away from the bench. No people.
shots.narration: 长发束起，手机不放在实验台上。

shots.section_title: 和上实验课一样的防护
shots.scene: 危险化学品在通风柜里操作，打勾
shots.prompt_en: A chemical bottle with a warning sign being handled inside a fume hood, with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 危险化学品规范操作，该进通风柜就进。

shots.scene: 欣欣站在岔路口，面前两块空白路牌
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands at a fork in the road with two blank signposts.
shots.narration: 规划将来，可以想好两个方向。

shots.scene: 一条路通向社区讲台，一条路通向演播室
shots.prompt_en: One road leads to a community lecture hall icon, the other to a studio camera icon. No people.
shots.narration: 比如为社区讲科学，或做自己的节目。

shots.scene: 主计划图标旁边有一个备用计划图标
shots.prompt_en: A main plan card icon with a smaller backup plan card icon beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 主计划之外，留个备选，心里更踏实。

shots.section_title: 迷茫时，想想最初的热爱
shots.scene: 阿杰望着窗外，想起小时候看星星
shots.prompt_en: The young male student looks out of the lab window, with a thought bubble showing a child looking at the stars.
shots.narration: 迷茫的时候，想想最初是什么吸引了你。
overlay: 迷茫时，想想最初的热爱

shots.section_title: 迷茫时，想想最初的热爱
shots.scene: 阿杰重新拿起实验报告，认真书写
shots.prompt_en: The young male student picks up his lab report again and writes with focus.
shots.narration: 跟着那份热爱走，

shots.section_title: 迷茫时，想想最初的热爱
shots.scene: 一条自己开出的小路通向山顶
shots.prompt_en: A small path carved through a hillside leading up to a sunny summit. No people.
shots.narration: 路也许难走，坚持下去就能到达。

shots.section_title: 迷茫时，想想最初的热爱
shots.scene: 阿杰戴好护目镜，开心地开始实验
shots.prompt_en: The young male student puts on his goggles and happily starts his experiment, the female graduate student nodding beside him.
shots.narration: 阿杰也想通了，重新投入实验。

shots.scene: 欣欣身旁浮现灯泡和地球图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside floating icons of a light bulb and a globe.
shots.narration: 好奇心出发，科学讲给每个人。

shots.scene: 专家、盾牌、四个台阶图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of an expert with a clipboard, a shield, and four steps going up. No people.
shots.narration: 听专家的，安全第一，四步走。

shots.scene: 护目镜、实验服、紧急喷淋图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of safety goggles, a lab coat and an emergency shower. No people.
shots.narration: 防护穿戴好，应急设施要认得。

shots.scene: 岔路路牌和星星图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a signpost at a fork and a shining star. No people.
shots.narration: 留好备选，迷茫时想想最初的热爱。

shots.scene: 欣欣、小研、阿杰在实验室里一起挥手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot, the female graduate student and the young male student wave goodbye together in a tidy lab.
shots.narration: 带着热爱，守住安全，谢谢观看！
